ollama._model_note: Default chat model. Any model you have pulled with Ollama works; change "model" and restart the API.
ollama._vision_note: vision_mode: off|auto|primary. auto = tesseract-first, VLM escalates on weak OCR. Model must be pulled on the host (ollama pull qwen2.5vl:7b).

models._vosk_note: vosk-model-en-us-0.22-lgraph (128MB) is much more accurate than vosk-model-small-en-us (40MB). Whisper replaces Vosk on the appliance.
models._piper_note: Natural FEMALE voice, AMERICAN accent (en_US-hfc_female-medium). Alternatives: models/en_GB-cori-high.onnx (English accent), models/en_US-lessac-medium.onnx. If the .onnx is missing, PiperTTS reports unavailable and the dashboard falls back to the browser voice (no lipsync).
models._embedding_note: chroma_default = chromadb's own ONNX all-MiniLM-L6-v2. It needs no extra package (onnxruntime ships with chromadb) and no model pulled, which is why it is the shipped default; the model files themselves are a one-time ~80 MB fetch behind the 'embedding_model_download' Bridge switch, or copy ~/.cache/chroma over by hand. 'sentence_transformers' is the same vectors via PyTorch and needs pip install -e ".[embeddings-legacy]". 'ollama' (nomic-embed-text) is a DIFFERENT vector space: flipping to it means re-indexing everything once. See src/puffpai/embeddings.py.

zone3._note: Zone 3 Network Edge — set enabled=true after running: docker compose -f docker-compose.zone3.yml up -d
